help.title: Help
help.publish_q: How do I post a product?
help.publish_a: Go to the "Post" tab, choose a category, add photos, a title, a description and a price, and confirm so it shows up in the feed.
help.contact_q: How do I contact a seller?
help.contact_a: Open a product's detail page and tap "Contact" to start a direct chat with the seller inside the app.
help.verification_a: From your profile you can start verification by uploading your university ID or a government ID. An administrator reviews the request and activates the matching badge.
help.report_q: How do I report a problem?
help.report_a: You'll find the report option on a user's profile or inside a chat. Describe the situation and the support team will review it.
help.support_a: Write to soporte@mercaditoum.site and we'll reply within 48 business hours.

safety.verify_profile_t: Check the profile before meeting up
safety.verify_profile_d: Review the rating, the reviews and whether the seller has the verification badge before arranging a handover.
safety.public_places_t: Meet in public areas on campus
safety.public_places_d: Prefer busy places like libraries, cafeterias or building entrances. Avoid isolated areas or spots off campus.
safety.check_product_d: Make sure the item matches the listing and works properly before completing the payment.
safety.no_prepayment_t: Be wary of upfront payments outside the app
safety.no_prepayment_d: Don't transfer money upfront to external accounts. Do the exchange in person, product and payment at the same time.
safety.report_suspicious_d: If someone asks for personal data, pressures you to leave the app, or looks like a scam, report them from their profile or contact support.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_body: Marketplace UM, part of Universidad de Montemorelos (hereinafter, "the Platform"), is the controller responsible for processing your personal data. Our address is located in Montemorelos, Nuevo León, Mexico.
privacy.s2_body:
We may collect the following categories of data:

• Identification data: full name, email address, phone number.
• Academic data: student ID, major, semester (for student accounts only).
• Official identification data: photo of your university ID or official identification (for verification purposes only).
• Business data: business name, type, location, hours (for business accounts only).
• Usage data: interactions on the Platform, listings, favorites, shopping cart.
• Technical data: IP address, device type, operating system, app version.
privacy.s3_body:
We use your personal data to:

Necessary purposes:
• Create and manage your account on the Platform.
• Enable the posting of products and services.
• Facilitate communication between buyers and sellers.
• Verify users' identity (when applicable).
• Send notifications about your activity on the Platform.
• Comply with legal obligations.

Optional purposes (subject to your consent):
• Send promotional communications about highlight plans.
• Perform statistical analysis to improve the Platform.
privacy.s4_body:
The processing of your data is based on:

• Your express consent when accepting this Privacy Policy.
• The contractual relationship arising from the Terms and Conditions.
• The Platform's legitimate interest in improving its services.
• Compliance with applicable legal obligations.
privacy.s5_body:
Your personal data will not be shared with third parties unrelated to the Platform, except:

• When necessary to comply with a legal obligation.
• When you have given express consent.
• With competent authorities in the exercise of their duties.

Profile data (name, photo, rating) is visible to other Platform users according to your settings.
privacy.s6_title: 6. Access, Rectification, Cancellation, and Objection (ARCO) rights
privacy.s6_body:
You have the right to:

• Access: Know what personal data we hold about you.
• Rectification: Request the correction of inaccurate data.
• Cancellation: Request the deletion of your data.
• Objection: Object to the processing of your data for specific purposes.

To exercise these rights, send an email to mercadito@um.edu.mx with the subject "ARCO Rights". We will respond to your request within a maximum of 20 business days.
privacy.s7_body: We implement administrative, technical, and physical security measures to protect your personal data against damage, loss, alteration, destruction, or unauthorized use. However, no transmission over the internet is completely secure.
privacy.s8_body: We retain your personal data for as long as you maintain an active account on the Platform. When you delete your account, we will retain certain information for the period required by applicable law for legal compliance and dispute resolution purposes.
privacy.s9_body: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience on the Platform. You can find more details in our Cookie Notice, available in the corresponding section.
privacy.s10_body: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be notified through the Platform. We recommend reviewing this policy periodically.
privacy.s11_body:
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or about the processing of your personal data, contact us at:

Email: mercadito@um.edu.mx
Address: Universidad de Montemorelos, Montemorelos, Nuevo León, Mexico.
privacy.footer: By using Marketplace UM, you confirm that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Use
terms.s1_body: By registering and using Marketplace UM ("the Platform"), you accept these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, you should not use the Platform. These terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you ("the User") and the administrators of Marketplace UM ("the Administration").
terms.s2_body: Marketplace UM is a university platform that connects members of the Universidad de Montemorelos community to buy, sell, and exchange products and services among students, academic staff, and local businesses near campus. The Platform acts solely as an intermediary and does not participate in transactions between users.
terms.s3_body:
To use Marketplace UM you must:

• Be at least 18 years old or have authorization from a legal guardian.
• Be a member of the UM community (student, faculty, staff) or an affiliated local business.
• Provide truthful and up-to-date information during registration.
• Not have a previously suspended account for violating these terms.
terms.s4_body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your password and for all activities that occur under your account. You must immediately notify the Administration of any unauthorized use of your account. The Administration will not be liable for losses arising from unauthorized use of your account.
terms.s5_body:
By using the Platform, you agree to:

• Not post prohibited products or services (weapons, illegal substances, fraudulent content, etc.).
• Not harass, threaten, or discriminate against other users.
• Not use the Platform for illegal or unauthorized purposes.
• Not interfere with the operation of the Platform.
• Not impersonate another person or entity.
• Post accurate descriptions and real photographs of products.

Failure to comply may result in the suspension or removal of your account without prior notice.
terms.s6_body:
By posting content on Marketplace UM, you represent that:

cookies.title: Cookie Notice
cookies.s1_body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, tablet, phone) when you visit an app or website. They allow the Platform to remember your preferences and improve your user experience.
cookies.s2_body:
Essential cookies: Necessary for the basic operation of the Platform. They enable user authentication, navigation, and access to secure features. Without these cookies, the Platform cannot function properly.

Preference cookies: Remember your preferences and settings (such as account type or search filters) to personalize your experience.

Analytics cookies: Collect anonymous information about how users interact with the Platform (most visited pages, time spent, errors). We use this information to improve the service.

Session cookies: Temporary, and deleted when you close the app. They keep your session active while you use the Platform.

• Block all cookies.

• Set up notifications before accepting cookies.
